summary_1line: Krishna teaches disciplined meditation and equanimity, assures that failed yogis are not lost, and declares devoted union with the divine the highest path.

image_candidates.scene_text: A solitary yogi sits on kusa grass and deer-skin, body straight and gaze fixed on the tip of his nose like a steady lamp in windless darkness.
Krishna speaks to Arjuna on the chariot while Arjuna gestures in frustration, comparing the restless mind to the uncontrollable wind.
A serene sage perceives all creatures within himself and himself within all beings, surrounded by animals and people in peaceful unity.
